_doc: Maps calculator asset-class keys (broker_ibkr.json keys) to lists of harness instrument-key patterns. Patterns are matched against `_instrument_key(df)` from quality/analyze.py, which produces strings of the form '<symbol>/<secType>' or '<symbol>/<secType>/<expiry>'. Use '*' as a wildcard for the expiry segment so any front- or back-month future qualifies.

_aliases._doc: Symbols where the calculator class differs from the natural harness secType. Reserved for future use.
